question_text: Three days after being admitted to the hospital for an appendectomy, a 69-year-old woman develops cough and dyspnea. The cough is productive of small amounts of green sputum. Her temperature is 39.0°C (102.2°F), pulse is 107/min, respirations are 31/min, and blood pressure is 89/68 mm Hg. Pulse oximetry on room air shows an oxygen saturation of 87%. Pulmonary examination shows diffuse crackles and rhonchi. An X-ray of the chest shows a left upper-lobe infiltrate of the lung. Two sets of blood cultures are obtained. While waiting for the results of the blood cultures, which of the following is the most appropriate pharmacotherapy?
